user_message: US-01: La ACT-MANAGER, toi muon approval chi tieu under 500 de xu ly nhanh. AC: spend under 500 chi can ACT-MANAGER approval.
US-01 xong. Mo US-02: La ACT-PO, toi muon approval chi tieu 500 or above de kiem soat ngan sach. AC: spend 500 or above requires ACT-PO approval; split invoices not allowed.
